title: Sharing what AI built: an open-source WebGPU ocean in three.js. Come build on it
author: xWranglerWranglerx
selftext:
we’re all doing ai dev right now and i want to help people out, so i’m sharing what my ai is making instead of sitting on it. also want to help regular people get into ai game dev, it’s way more doable than people think



this is an endless ocean running in the browser. fft waves, volumetric clouds, rain, storms, lightning. no textures, it’s all computed. started as a fork of open-water by Leonxlnx (go look at his stuff, he did the hard part) and my ai agents ported it to three.js webgpu



it’s all MIT. agent instructions and the dumb traps the ai hit are in the repo too, so steal the workflow if you want



no live demo yet, you have to run it locally. holds 60fps at 4k on my 5080, tell me what you get on your gpu



stuff i could use help with: non nvidia gpus, other browsers, the night and squall scenes look wrong, performance. or just tell me what you’d build with it lol



[https://github.com/teddybuild/three-js-ocean-dweller](https://github.com/teddybuild/three-js-ocean-dweller)
